page.layout: One page of title text, centred, printed upside down on the scan. Lines run top to bottom in one block, with a woodcut vignette (a seated figure) between the lower text groups. No running head, page number or signature.

main_text.l: QVOD HOC ANNO M.D.LX. ET SEQ.
in Nubium Colonia, iure Ciuitatis Vrbis [?]
editum, [illegible, ~8 letters] Canonicum ad D. Sum[?]
Cum gratia et priuilegio Caesareo Maiestatis.

page.notes: The page is printed upside down on the scan, so the lines were read in their printed order after turning. Many lines are worn, faint or show-through from the reverse, so the readings marked [?] or [illegible] are uncertain. The vignette is a woodcut illustration with no text. The Latin of the middle block and the printer's name line could not be read reliably.
